sources.quote: SHIELD, the AI security layer on Intents, detected outlier behavior and Intents were temporarily paused.

returned.note: Returned after a 48-hour deadline; NEAR Intents' general manager announced the full return and closed the investigation. Return transactions and asset not identified in sources read. The operator had pledged full compensation before the return.

sources.quote: The funds from the $3.8M NEAR Intents hack were sent back in full.
We've returned all the funds, we were in the wrong.
